name: Maintenance
description: Scheduled repository maintenance: an agent you pick runs the maintain skill on the repositories you choose, updating dependencies, fixing security advisories, correcting docs that drifted and filling coverage gaps, one commit per category behind the repository's own gates. Each run reports what it applied and what it deferred; you decide whether its branch stays in HAL-C2 or becomes a pull request.

permissions.reason: To find the project of each repository it maintains, and run its agent in that project.
To skip a run while the repository still has an open maintenance pull request.
Only when publishing allows it: to push a run's maintenance branch and open its pull request. Nothing is pushed while publishing keeps runs in HAL-C2 or waits for you.
Each run is a thread of the agent you chose, in the repository's project.
To find the worktree a run's branch is in when its pull request is opened.
To stop a run you cancel, and settle a run's thread once it ends.
A run's agent reports what it applied and deferred through a tool of this plugin.

settings.label: Repositories
settings.description: owner/name of each repository to maintain. Each needs a checkout of it as a project on this MC.

settings.label: At
settings.description: HH:MM, in this MC's local time. A run missed while the MC was off starts once when it is back.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Report only changes nothing and says what it would do. Fix works on a maintenance/<date> branch in a new worktree, never on the default branch.

settings.label: Categories
settings.description: Any of deps, security-alerts, docs-drift and coverage-gaps.

settings.label: Security advisories only
settings.description: Only fix open security advisories, each with the smallest safe upgrade, and leave the rest.

settings.label: Agent
settings.description: The provider instance that maintains, such as claudeAgent or codex.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Empty for the agent's default model.

settings.label: Prompt
settings.default: Maintain {{repository}} by following the maintain skill at {{skill}}: read it and the roles it names before you start. Mode: {{mode}}. Categories: {{categories}}. Today is {{date}}.
settings.description: {{repository}}, {{mode}}, {{categories}}, {{branch}}, {{base}}, {{date}} and {{skill}} are filled in. The rules every run keeps, and how to report, are added after it.

settings.label: Per-repository instructions
settings.description: {"owner/name": "text"}: added to that repository's prompt, such as which gates to run or what to leave alone.

options.label: Wait for me to open the pull request
